briefdescription.para: Test SSL context initialization with valid system paths.
Test mTLS requires all certificate paths.
getIdealConnectionCount scales up under high load
getIdealConnectionCount scales down under low load
getIdealConnectionCount is stable in the normal operating range
shouldCreateConnection returns true when pool is exhausted
shouldCreateConnection returns false when pool is full
shouldCreateConnection returns true for an empty pool
shouldRemoveConnection returns true when idle long enough
shouldRemoveConnection returns false when idle time is below threshold
shouldRemoveConnection respects the minimum pool floor
shouldRemoveConnection returns false when no idle connections available
Pool with adaptive sizing enabled initialises correctly.
Pool with custom adaptive strategy uses provided strategy.
Stats.utilization is 0 when no connections exist.
Stats.pool_size_adaptations is exposed as a zero-init counter.
getIdealConnectionCount returns current when load is exactly at scale_up_threshold (boundary: equal is not greater-than, so no scale-up)
getIdealConnectionCount returns current when load is exactly at scale_down_threshold (boundary: equal is not less-than, so no scale-down)
Verify that getIdealConnectionCount scale-down result never drops below 1.
Pool with adaptive sizing disabled does not call adaptPoolSize (stats.pool_size_adaptations stays 0 even after pruning).
shouldCreateConnection agrees with getIdealConnectionCount for scale-up: When load is high (> scale_up_threshold) ideal is larger, AND the pool is not full, shouldCreate should return true.

shouldRemoveConnection agrees with getIdealConnectionCount for scale-down: When load is low (< scale_down_threshold) ideal is smaller, AND idle time exceeds min_idle_time, shouldRemove should return true.
